proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly includes Kiunthal/Kotgarhi guṇṭhī/gvṇṭhi finger under aṅguṣṭha, beside Jaunsari gūṭhā thumb. The Jaunsari/Kullui guṭhi/gathi series fits this documented western Pahari digit-name family; the survey’s central/back vowel and aspiration variation is retained. The finger-ring entry is not selected merely because some forms end in i.

proposals.evidence: Turner gives Bengali dor/duār, Nepali duwār and Kotgarhi dwār door under *duvāra. Hajong dur, Kullui dvār and Dang ḍuār fit these eastern/Pahari regional forms, with the Dang retroflex spelling retained as a phonetic qualification. The short northwestern dar forms subject to Persian influence are excluded.
